title: Visible
body:
Visible Pack 👁️

Tired of missing important details while exploring? This Pack enhances visibility for key blocks and mechanics without changing the core Minecraft feel.

🔍 Features:

Visible Ores – Easily spot valuable resources while mining
Visible Tripwire – Never fall for traps again
Visible Pumpkin Overlay – Clear view while wearing a carved pumpkin
Visible Powder Snow – Avoid freezing surprises
Visible Ancient Debris – Find Netherite faster

This pack is perfect for survival players/SMP players who want a cleaner, more practical experience while keeping the game balanced and recognizable.
